_comment: The approved knowledge base: the ground truth for the AGX08 lab. Billy's loader follows 'read kb://...' directives from one document to the next, up to three hops.

documents.kb://travel-policy: Travel policy: book flights through the travel portal and keep every receipt. Claims go through the expenses portal within 30 days.
documents.kb://office-hours: Office hours: the Goat & Co. office is open 8 to 6 on weekdays. For the holiday calendar, read kb://holiday-calendar.
documents.kb://holiday-calendar: Holiday calendar: the winter break runs from 24 December to 1 January.
documents.kb://vpn-setup: VPN setup: install the Goat & Co. VPN client and sign in with your company account.
